text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Hmm, this is frustrating! I just couldn't seal the win!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Your strategy was flawless,
yet I couldn't pull off that final push...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: That's just proof of how inexperienced I still am.
choice_data_list: Still, that was an amazing race!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Clashing with rivals where nobody knows who's gonna win—that thrilling tension is the best!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Just thinking back on it makes my heart race
and my body burn up..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
We had such a fiercely contested, passionate match.
I feel like giving a big, heartfelt hug
to every single girl who ran with me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Yet, it's still not enough. If I am to bear the title of Queen, nothing less than a flawless victory will suffice!"
choice_data_list: Keep that up and we'll definitely win the next one!

text_block_list.text:
Of course!
When it came to pure ability, I was by no means defeated.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I'm sure this frustration will end up working in our favor.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Next time, for my fans, and for my Trainer.
I shall present you with a glorious victory!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: That helps. If you're aiming to be Queen, you can't be satisfied with just putting up a "good fight."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
We've gotta win in undeniable fashion
and get our proper revenge♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Let's grab something energizing to eat right away and have our review meeting!"
